research_question: Can a bounded MLCNN-feature fallback remove the repeatedly observed SawFM sweep-period negative transfer while retaining the IQ-Grouped route's gains on the other 11 parameters?

mechanism.single_change: replace only normalized SawFM sweep-period output with a 32-unit scalar head on detached MLCNN classification features
mechanism.protected_outputs: classification logits and the other 11 parameter outputs keep the P4c routing structure
mechanism.gradient_contract: SawFM fallback loss updates only the small fallback head; it cannot update the MLCNN classification backbone

stop_rule: If the SawFM target gate fails, stop the learned fallback line. If another target or classification gate fails, do not tune on seed690000000; freeze it for attribution and redesign only on new identities.
next_if_pass: Freeze the fallback and run two new generator seeds without training or recalibration, followed by strict MAC matching.
